# Surfaces v12

- Time lines are gone. A recipe's scenarios carry no `Line:` field — plain, raised or frozen — and
  no `Workload:` field, `harness.md` carries no `headroom:` or `raise:` setting, and the tool has
  no `line`, `raise` or `freeze` command and no exit 5: a passing `drive` exits 0 however long it
  took, and runs each scenario once. The tool refuses a leftover field, naming it, so `verify
  check` fails until it is deleted.
- In their place, one principle in the harness guidance (*Run time*): every run reports how long it
  took, and that is the only time signal. Keep checks fast and treat a slow harness as friction to
  fix; never block, gate, fail, ticket or exit non-zero on run time, and never make a check faster
  by having it check less. *Fit to trust* loses its fast-enough job.
- Run time alone is still not a reason for the ask-first mark.
- A project that verifies its own way gains nothing here.
